name: Progress ring
what: Progress you can see: a ring fills to its percent with the number counting and a check popping; a ring drawing around a symbol that pops and glows; or a ticket card whose bar fills with a glowing tip.

learned_from.what: a green ring filling to 78 %, a check popping
a ring drawing around a green dollar that pops
a dark ticket card, a green bar filling

motion: fills 50 f (S-curve) with the count; the check back.out 12 f; the symbol pops and the glow breathes
